=== rows over one- and two-word instructions
	.arch avr5
	.file 1 "main.c"
	.text
	.globl main
main:
	.loc 1 3 0
	ldi r24, lo8(msg)
	ldi r25, hi8(msg)
	.loc 1 4 5 prologue_end
	call puts
	.loc 1 5 1
	lds r0, var
	sts var, r1
	.loc 1 6 1 is_stmt 0
	jmp main
	.data
msg:	.asciz "hi"
var:	.byte 0
=== rows around branches, which are left to the linker
	.file 1 "loop.c"
	.text
f:
	.loc 1 10 0
	ldi r24, 10
.L2:
	.loc 1 11 3
	dec r24
	.loc 1 11 3
	brne .L2
	.loc 1 12 1
	rcall f
	ret
=== rows around alignment and .org, which are recorded in .avr.prop
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1 0
	nop
	.balign 4
	.loc 1 2 0
	nop
	.org 0x10
	.loc 1 3 0
	ret
=== a frame as avr-gcc writes one
	.file 1 "frame.c"
	.text
	.globl f
	.type f, @function
f:
	.loc 1 2 1
	.cfi_startproc
	push r28
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 3
	.cfi_offset 28, -2
	push r29
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 4
	.cfi_offset 29, -3
	in r28, 0x3d
	in r29, 0x3e
	.cfi_def_cfa_register 28
	sbiw r28, 4
	.loc 1 3 5 prologue_end
	std Y+1, r24
	.loc 1 4 1
	adiw r28, 4
	.cfi_def_cfa_register 32
	pop r29
	.cfi_restore 29
	pop r28
	.cfi_restore 28
	.cfi_def_cfa_offset 2
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
	.size f, .-f
=== frames in .debug_frame, for a core with a 22-bit program counter
	.arch avr6
	.cfi_sections .debug_frame
	.text
g:
	.cfi_startproc
	push r16
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset 1
	.cfi_rel_offset 16, 0
	eicall
	pop r16
	.cfi_adjust_cfa_offset -1
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
=== two code sections
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.section .init0, "ax", @progbits
	.loc 1 1 0
	clr r1
	.loc 1 2 0
	out 0x3f, r1
	.text
	.loc 1 5 0
	nop
	.section .init0, "ax", @progbits
	.loc 1 3 0
	nop
=== the source itself | -g
	.text
	.globl __vectors
__vectors:
	rjmp reset
	rjmp reset
reset:
	ldi r16, 0xff
	out 0x17, r16
1:	sbi 0x18, 0
	cbi 0x18, 0
	rjmp 1b
=== the source through a macro and a loop | -g
	.macro toggle bit
	sbi 0x18, \bit
	cbi 0x18, \bit
	.endm
	.text
f:	toggle 0
	.rept 2
	nop
	.endr
	toggle 1
	ret
=== the source in two sections with alignment | -g
	.section .vectors, "ax", @progbits
	rjmp main
	.balign 4
	.text
main:
	ldi r24, 1
	.p2align 2
	ret
=== the source as DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.text
	nop
	ldi r30, lo8(pm(f))
	ldi r31, hi8(pm(f))
f:	icall
	ret
